top module named arbiter. Any helper modules must be included in the same block,
instantiated by this circuit, and uniquely named. Do not include a testbench or

                { "name": "request", "direction": "input", "width": "PORTS", "clock_domain": "clk" },
                { "name": "acknowledge", "direction": "input", "width": "PORTS", "clock_domain": "clk" },
                { "name": "grant", "direction": "output", "width": "PORTS", "clock_domain": "clk" },
                { "name": "grant_valid", "direction": "output", "width": 1, "clock_domain": "clk" },
                { "name": "grant_encoded", "direction": "output", "width": "$clog2(PORTS)", "clock_domain": "clk" }
            ],

                { "name": "grant_block", "width": 1 },
                { "name": "round_robin_counter", "width": "$clog2(PORTS)" }
            ],
            "behavior": [
                "On reset (rst), initialize current_grant to 0 and grant_block to 0.",
                "Synchronize all operations to the rising edge of the clock (clk).",
                "If ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN is 1, update round_robin_counter to the next requester in a round-robin fashion.",
                "Determine next_grant based on the request signals and current priority settings (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY).",
                "If ARB_BLOCK is 1 and the current grant is blocked (acknowledge[current_grant] is not ARB_BLOCK_ACK), set grant_block to 1.",
                "If grant_block is 0, update current_grant to next_grant and set grant_valid to 1.",
                "Otherwise, maintain the current_grant and set grant_valid to 0.",
                "Encode the current_grant into the grant_encoded output.",
                "Drive the grant output based on the one-hot encoded current_grant."
            ]
        }
    ]
}
